auth.description:
To obtain your API key, follow these steps:

1. Log in to your MailerLite account.
2. Visit the [API page](https://dashboard.mailerlite.com/integrations/api).
3. Click the **Generate new token** button.
4. Copy the generated API key.

add_subscriber_to_group.name: add_subscriber_to_group
add_subscriber_to_group.description: Adds existing subscriber to a specific group.

aiMetadata.description: Assign an existing MailerLite subscriber to a group, given the subscriber ID and group ID. Use this to segment a contact you already have into a list/group. The subscriber must already exist. Idempotent — re-running for a subscriber already in the group leaves membership unchanged.

add_or_update_subscriber.name: add_or_update_subscriber
add_or_update_subscriber.description: Create a new subscriber or updates an existing one if the email already exists.

status.description: If empty, status Active is used by default.

aiMetadata.description: Upsert a MailerLite subscriber by email: creates the contact if the email is new, otherwise updates the existing record (status, custom fields, group membership, opt-in metadata). Use this to add or sync a contact when you only have their email. Idempotent — keyed on email, so repeating with the same input converges on the same subscriber state.

find_subscriber.name: find_subscriber
find_subscriber.description: Search for subscriber by email or name.

aiMetadata.description: Look up a single MailerLite subscriber by their email address or subscriber ID. Use this to resolve a contact to their record (status, fields, groups) before updating or segmenting them. Read-only and idempotent.

remove_subscriber_from_group.name: remove_subscriber_from_group
remove_subscriber_from_group.description: Removes subscriber from a specific group.

aiMetadata.description: Unassign a MailerLite subscriber from a group, given the subscriber ID and group ID. Use this to remove a contact from a specific list/group without deleting the subscriber. Idempotent — re-running for a subscriber not in the group leaves membership unchanged.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

subscriber.created.name: subscriber.created
subscriber.created.description: Triggers when a subscriber was created on your mailing list.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new subscriber is added to the MailerLite account, regardless of source (manual, form, import, API). Represents a newly created contact and carries the subscriber record.

subscriber.updated.name: subscriber.updated
subscriber.updated.description: Triggers when the subscriber fields have been updated.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an existing subscriber's fields (name, custom fields, or other profile attributes) are changed. Represents an update to a contact's record and carries the updated subscriber.

subscriber.unsubscribed.name: subscriber.unsubscribed
subscriber.unsubscribed.description: Triggers when a subscriber has unsubscribed from your mailing list.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a subscriber unsubscribes from the mailing list, with their status set to unsubscribed. Represents a contact opting out and carries the affected subscriber.

subscriber.added_to_group.name: subscriber.added_to_group
subscriber.added_to_group.description: Triggers when a subscriber is added to a group.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a subscriber is assigned to a group/segment. Represents group membership being granted and carries both the subscriber and the group it was added to.
